description: Read-only clean-room probe verifying GetPixelFromBMP returns 0 and leaves caller out-variables untouched when the BMP file is missing.

batches.title: Wave 6D-3: GetPixelFromBMP preserves out-vars on failure

probes.claim: Verify GetPixelFromBMP return value and output-var preservation on missing BMP file.
probes.expected: Check whether missing BMP leaves pre-seeded (111,222,333) unchanged or zeros them.
script_lines: int iRet1 = GetPixelFromBMP "Data\W6D3_NoSuch.bmp" fR1 fG1 fB1 0 0
int iRet3 = GetPixelFromBMP "Data\W6D3_NoSuch.bmp" fR3 fG3 fB3 -1 -1
PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d3p3_13_get_pixel_from_bmp_missing_only|miss=%g(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)|neg=%g(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)" iRet1 fR1 fG1 fB1 iRet3 fR3 fG3 fB3
